physical_skill: Grip a 30 cm, 0.35 kg level on its exposed part, keep it within 1.5 cm of the table while drawing it 13 cm sideways until its hidden end clears a loose board resting on two blocks (with a glass on it), only then raise it and set it flat on a mat, and let go.
valid_shortcuts: One arm drawing the level out low earns 1.0; that is a valid route and is stated in the README.
Sliding the level along the table without lifting it at all is valid if the board and glass stay put.
Lifting the glass off first and putting it back within 1 cm earns 1.0 if the board never tilts past 5 degrees; it is a safe alternative and is not forbidden.
Lifting the level straight up (two arms or one) levers the board past 5 degrees: 0 (red-teamed).
Holding the level on the mat without releasing scores 0 (fingertip clearance check, red-teamed).
